title: Prospective Memory for Proactive LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.05731v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Most memory systems for LLM agents are retrospective, preserving and retrieving past information to inform current decisions. Proactive agents, however, also require prospective memory: retaining future-directed intentions and realizing them when appropriate opportunities arise, even without explicit requests. Crucially, remembering the right intention does not guarantee acting at the right time: a related observation may call for waiting, while a later cue may make the same intention actionable. Inspired by cognitive theories of human prospective memory, we introduce Pro-Memory, a memory framework that separates maintaining future intentions from deciding when and how to realize them. Pro-Memory preserves pending objectives linked to their supporting evidence, assesses new observations against their original goals and activation conditions, and coordinates appropriate contributions with the agent's ongoing actions. translated_title: 面向主动式LLM智能体的前瞻记忆
translated_abstract: 大多数面向LLM智能体的记忆系统都是回顾性的，即保存和检索过去的信息以辅助当前的决策。然而，主动式智能体还需要前瞻记忆：保留面向未来的意图，并在合适的时机出现时将其实现，即使没有明确的请求。关键在于，记住正确的意图并不能保证在正确的时机行动：一个相关的观察可能需要等待，而稍后的线索可能使同一意图变得可以执行。受人类前瞻记忆认知理论的启发，我们提出了Pro-Memory，一个将维护未来意图与决定何时以及如何实现它们相分离的记忆框架。Pro-Memory保存待处理的目标并将其与支持证据相关联，依据原始目标和激活条件评估新的观察，并与智能体正在进行的行动协调适当的贡献。它还进一步更新……
tldr: 提出受人类前瞻记忆启发的Pro-Memory框架，为主动式LLM智能体引入前瞻记忆，将维护未来意图与判断实现时机相分离，使智能体能在合适的时机自主兑现未来目标。
en_tdlr: Pro-Memory is a prospective memory framework for proactive LLM agents, inspired by human cognitive theories, that separates maintaining future intentions from deciding when and how to realize them, enabling agents to act on pending goals at the right moment.
